caption: Two Canoes LLC v. Addian Inc.
citation_line: Two Canoes LLC v. Addian Inc., No. 2:21-cv-19729, ECF No. 72 (D.N.J. Apr. 21, 2023)
headnote_district_ruling: Allowed subpoenas on a U.S. national believed to be abroad through email, WhatsApp, text, and WeChat. The court analyzed Rule 45, alternative service, and the Walsh Act while preserving later jurisdictional objections.
qualification_rationale: A comparatively unusual and immediately useful treatment of cross-border subpoena practice and electronic service when a witness's location is uncertain.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive discovery order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Alternative service of a subpoena and cross-border discovery mechanics only.
